questions.prompt: Choose the word that means 「準時的」.
questions.explanation: punctual（adj.）準時的。例：She is always punctual for meetings.

questions.prompt: What does "itinerary" mean?
questions.explanation: itinerary（n.）旅行行程、路線規劃。例：Our itinerary includes three days in Kyoto.

questions.prompt: Choose the word that means 「截止日期」.
questions.explanation: deadline（n.）截止期限。headline 是標題、timeline 是時間軸、guideline 是指導方針。

questions.prompt: What does "reluctant" mean?
questions.explanation: reluctant（adj.）不情願的、勉強的。常用 be reluctant to + V。例：He was reluctant to admit his mistake.

questions.prompt: Which word means 「食材；原料」?
questions.explanation: ingredient（n.）（烹飪的）材料、成分。例：Mix all the ingredients in a bowl.

questions.prompt: What does "ubiquitous" mean?
questions.explanation: ubiquitous（adj.）無所不在的、隨處可見的。例：Smartphones have become ubiquitous.

optionNotes.罕見的: 罕見的是 rare（正好是 ubiquitous 的反義）

questions.prompt: She ___ to the gym every morning.
questions.explanation: 主詞 She 是第三人稱單數，現在簡單式動詞要加 -s/-es：goes。

optionNotes.go: 主詞是第三人稱單數 She，現在式動詞要加 -es
optionNotes.going: going 是現在分詞，前面要有 be 動詞（is going）
optionNotes.gone: gone 是過去分詞，要搭配 has（has gone）

questions.prompt: If I ___ more time, I would travel around the world.
questions.explanation: 與現在事實相反的假設語氣：If + 過去式, S + would + V。所以用 had。

optionNotes.have: 與現在事實相反的假設，if 子句要用過去式，不能用現在式
optionNotes.am having: have 表示「擁有」時一般不用進行式

questions.prompt: I have lived in Taipei ___ 2015.
questions.explanation: 現在完成式搭配「時間起點」用 since；搭配「一段時間」用 for（for ten years）。

optionNotes.for: for 接「一段時間」，例如 for eight years
optionNotes.from: from 2015 要搭配 to/until，例如 from 2015 to 2020
optionNotes.during: during 接「一段期間」名詞，例如 during the summer

questions.prompt: The report ___ by the manager before the meeting started.
questions.explanation: 報告「被」審閱 → 被動語態；又發生在「會議開始（過去）」之前 → 過去完成式被動：had been reviewed。

optionNotes.was reviewed: 過去簡單式被動，但沒有表達「在會議開始之前就已完成」
optionNotes.has reviewed: 主動語態，而且報告不會自己審閱
optionNotes.reviews: 現在式主動，時態與語態都不對

questions.prompt: Neither the teacher nor the students ___ ready.
questions.explanation: neither A nor B 當主詞時，動詞跟最靠近的 B（students，複數）一致，所以用 were。

optionNotes.was: 動詞要跟較近的主詞 students（複數）一致
optionNotes.be: 原形動詞不能直接當主要動詞

questions.prompt: Could you please turn ___ the lights when you leave? (關掉)
questions.explanation: turn off 關掉（電器）；turn on 打開。

questions.prompt: I'm looking forward ___ hearing from you.
questions.explanation: look forward to + V-ing：期待……。這裡的 to 是介系詞，後面接動名詞 hearing。

questions.prompt: Please fill in the past tense of "buy": Yesterday I ___ a new laptop.
questions.explanation: buy 的過去式與過去分詞都是 bought（不規則動詞）。

questions.prompt: The flight was delayed ___ to bad weather.
questions.explanation: due to + 名詞：由於……。because 後面要接子句或 because of + 名詞。owing to 也可以，但這裡已有 to，選 due 最常見。

optionNotes.because: because 後面要接子句；接名詞要用 because of
optionNotes.since: since 當「因為」時後面接子句
optionNotes.owing: owing to 也可以，但 due to 是最常見的搭配

questions.prompt: Can I have the ___, please? (餐廳結帳時說的「帳單」，美式)
questions.explanation: 美式英文說 check，英式英文說 bill，兩者都可以接受。

questions.prompt: Which sentence is the most polite way to ask for help?
questions.explanation: Would you mind + V-ing? 是很禮貌的請求句型。回答「好」要說 Not at all.（不介意）。

命令句，聽起來很直接、不禮貌
must 是「必須」，帶有強迫意味
雖然有 please，但 now 讓語氣很急促

questions.prompt: At the airport check-in counter, what does "aisle seat" mean?
questions.explanation: aisle（發音 /aɪl/，s 不發音）走道。window seat 是靠窗、middle seat 是中間。

questions.prompt: "Let's touch base next week." What does the speaker want to do?
questions.explanation: touch base（片語）簡短聯絡、交流近況，職場常用。

optionNotes.去打棒球: base 雖然是棒球的「壘」，但 touch base 是職場片語
optionNotes.取消會議: 取消會議是 cancel the meeting

questions.prompt: Which word is a synonym of "enormous"?
questions.explanation: enormous ≈ huge ≈ massive（巨大的）。tiny 微小、ordinary 普通、fragile 易碎。

optionNotes.tiny: tiny（adj.）極小的，是 enormous 的反義

questions.prompt: What does "invoice" mean?

questions.prompt: What does "candidate" mean?

questions.prompt: Choose the word that means 「延期」.

questions.prompt: What does "revenue" mean?

questions.prompt: Choose the word that means 「場地；舉辦地點」.
questions.explanation: venue（n.）場地；舉辦地點。例：The venue for the conference has been changed.

questions.prompt: What does "subsidiary" mean?

questions.prompt: Choose the word that means 「每季的」.

questions.prompt: What does "merger" mean?

questions.prompt: What does "warranty" mean?
questions.explanation: warranty（n.）保固。例：The laptop comes with a two-year warranty.

questions.prompt: Choose the word that means 「宣傳小冊子」.

questions.prompt: Choose the word that means 「通勤」.

questions.prompt: What does "tenant" mean?
questions.explanation: tenant（n.）房客；承租人。例：The tenant signed a one-year lease.

questions.prompt: Choose the word that means 「到期；失效」.

optionNotes.作品集；投資組合: 「作品集；投資組合」的英文是 portfolio

questions.prompt: Choose the word that means 「全體員工；人事部門」.

questions.prompt: The manager asked all staff to submit their reports ___ Friday.
questions.explanation: by + 時間點 = 「在…之前（完成）」，用於期限。

optionNotes.until: until 表示動作「持續到」某時，例如 wait until Friday；繳交是一次性動作，要用 by
optionNotes.at: at 用於時刻，例如 at 5 p.m.
optionNotes.in: in 用於月份、年份，例如 in May

questions.prompt: Ms. Chen is responsible ___ training new employees.
questions.explanation: be responsible for + 名詞 / V-ing：負責…

optionNotes.of: 沒有 be responsible of 的用法，是常見錯誤
optionNotes.to: be responsible to + 人 = 向某人負責（例如向主管報告），後面不接工作內容

questions.prompt: The new software is ___ than the old version.

optionNotes.most efficient: 最高級要搭配 the，且不能和 than 連用
optionNotes.efficient: 有 than 必須用比較級

questions.prompt: Please contact our customer service team if you have ___ questions.

optionNotes.little: little 接不可數名詞，且表示「幾乎沒有」

questions.prompt: The conference room ___ for the training session tomorrow.

optionNotes.reserve: 主詞是單數 room，而且語態錯誤

questions.prompt: ___ the heavy rain, the outdoor event was not canceled.

optionNotes.Although: Although 後面要接完整子句，例如 Although it rained heavily
optionNotes.Because: 語意相反（因為下雨所以沒取消不合理），且 because 後面接子句

questions.prompt: Mr. Lee has worked at the company ___ more than ten years.
questions.explanation: 現在完成式 + for + 一段時間（more than ten years）。

optionNotes.since: since 接「時間起點」，例如 since 2015
optionNotes.during: during 接「某段期間的名稱」，例如 during the summer
optionNotes.while: while 是連接詞，後面接子句

questions.prompt: All visitors are required ___ at the front desk.
questions.explanation: be required to + 原形動詞：被要求做…

optionNotes.signing in: require 的被動用法後面接不定詞 to V，不接 V-ing
optionNotes.signed in: 過去分詞不能接在 be required 後面

questions.prompt: The report must be ___ before it is sent to the client.

optionNotes.carefully review: be 後面要接過去分詞 reviewed（被動）
optionNotes.careful review: be + 形容詞 + 名詞，語意變成「報告是一個仔細的審查」，不合理

questions.prompt: We look forward to ___ with you again.

optionNotes.work: to 在這裡是介系詞不是不定詞，不能接原形動詞
optionNotes.worked: 介系詞後面不能接過去式
optionNotes.be working: 介系詞後面不接 be 動詞原形

questions.prompt: The shipment was delayed, ___ caused problems for our customers.

optionNotes.that: that 不能用在逗號後的非限定關係子句
optionNotes.what: what = the thing that，不能修飾前面的內容
optionNotes.it: 用 it 會變成兩個句子中間沒有連接詞（run-on sentence）

questions.prompt: If the package ___ by Monday, please let me know.
questions.explanation: 表示條件的 if 子句用現在式代替未來式。

optionNotes.will not arrive: 條件子句不用 will 表示未來
optionNotes.did not arrived: did 後面要接原形動詞，而且時態也不對

questions.prompt: The hotel offers a free shuttle service ___ the airport and the city center.
questions.explanation: between A and B：在 A 與 B 之間。

optionNotes.among: among 用於三者以上之間
optionNotes.from: from 要搭配 to（from A to B）
optionNotes.through: through 是「穿過」，不搭配 and

questions.prompt: Ms. Park is the person ___ you should speak to about the refund.
questions.explanation: 先行詞是人（the person），在子句中當 to 的受詞 → whom（口語也可用 who 或省略）。

optionNotes.which: which 用來指事物，不能指人
optionNotes.whose: whose 表示所有格，後面要接名詞

questions.prompt: Applicants should have ___ experience in sales.
questions.explanation: 修飾名詞 experience 要用形容詞：extensive 豐富的、廣泛的。

optionNotes.extend: 動詞「延長」，不能放在名詞前修飾
optionNotes.extension: 名詞「延長；分機」，放這裡語意不通

questions.prompt: The company has decided to ___ its operations to Asia.
questions.explanation: decide to + 原形動詞：expand 擴展。

optionNotes.expansion: 名詞，to 後面要接動詞原形
optionNotes.expanding: to 在這裡是不定詞，不接 V-ing

questions.prompt: Profits rose ___ in the third quarter.
questions.explanation: 修飾動詞 rose 要用副詞：significantly 顯著地。

questions.prompt: Please make sure the door is locked ___ you leave the office.
questions.explanation: before + 子句：在…之前。

optionNotes.during: during 後面接名詞，不接子句
optionNotes.despite: despite 表示讓步「儘管」，且後接名詞
optionNotes.between: between 要搭配 A and B

questions.prompt: By the time the manager arrived, the meeting ___.

optionNotes.already starts: 現在式與過去的情境不符
optionNotes.will start: 未來式與過去情境矛盾

questions.prompt: The training session will be held ___ the second floor.

optionNotes.in: in 用於建築物或房間內部，如 in the building
optionNotes.at: at 用於地點的點，如 at the reception
optionNotes.to: to 表示方向，不用於「在某層」

questions.prompt: Each of the employees ___ received a new laptop.

optionNotes.are: are 是複數 be 動詞，而且 are received 語意不對

questions.prompt: The CEO, along with her assistants, ___ expected to attend.

questions.prompt: The flight was canceled ___ the storm.

optionNotes.although: although 表示「雖然」，語意不符且後接子句

questions.prompt: The new policy applies to ___ full-time and part-time employees.
questions.explanation: both A and B：A 和 B 兩者都。

optionNotes.all: all 不搭配 and 的雙項結構

questions.prompt: Customers can pay ___ by credit card or in cash.
questions.explanation: either A or B：A 或 B 擇一。

optionNotes.neither: neither 要搭配 nor，且語意變成兩種都不行
optionNotes.whether: whether A or B 用來引導子句（是否），不用在這裡

questions.prompt: The marketing team is ___ busy to take on another project right now.
questions.explanation: too + 形容詞 + to V：太…而不能…

optionNotes.so: so 要搭配 that 子句（so busy that…）
optionNotes.very: very 不能搭配 to V 表示「以致於不能」
optionNotes.enough: enough 放在形容詞後面（busy enough），而且語意相反

questions.prompt: This is the ___ proposal we have received so far.
questions.explanation: the + 最高級 + 名詞 + so far：到目前為止最…

optionNotes.detailed: 有 the 和 so far 表示最高級

questions.prompt: Mr. Garcia ___ in the sales department since 2019.
questions.explanation: since + 過去時間點，主要子句用現在完成式。

optionNotes.works: 現在簡單式不能搭配 since
optionNotes.worked: 過去式表示已結束，和 since 不合
optionNotes.is working: 現在進行式不搭配 since 表示持續

questions.prompt: Would you mind ___ the meeting minutes to everyone?
questions.explanation: Would you mind + V-ing：可以請你…嗎？

optionNotes.to send: mind 後面接動名詞，不接不定詞

questions.prompt: The seminar was so ___ that many people fell asleep.
questions.explanation: -ing 形容詞描述「讓人有某種感覺的事物」：研討會令人無聊 → boring。

optionNotes.bored: -ed 形容詞描述「人」的感受，例如 The people were bored
optionNotes.bore: 動詞或名詞「無聊的人／事」

questions.prompt: The staff were ___ about the new bonus system.
questions.explanation: 描述「人」的感受用 -ed 形容詞：員工感到興奮 → excited。

optionNotes.exciting: -ing 形容詞描述「令人興奮的事物」

questions.prompt: ___ you need any assistance, please do not hesitate to contact me.
questions.explanation: Should you need… = If you should need…（條件句倒裝，正式書信常用）。

optionNotes.Would: would 不能用在這種條件倒裝
optionNotes.Could: Could you… 是請求句型，與後面的 please 句子不連貫
optionNotes.Had: Had 倒裝用於「與過去事實相反」，後面要接過去分詞

questions.prompt: The products ___ in this factory are exported to Europe.
questions.explanation: 過去分詞片語修飾名詞（= which are manufactured）：在這間工廠「被製造」的產品。

optionNotes.manufacturing: 現在分詞表示主動，產品不會自己製造
optionNotes.manufacture: 原形動詞不能修飾名詞
optionNotes.are manufactured: 句子會有兩個主要動詞（are manufactured / are exported）

questions.prompt: Please return the signed contract ___ the enclosed envelope.
questions.explanation: 放在信封「裡」→ in the envelope。

optionNotes.at: at 表示地點的點，不表示「在…裡面」
optionNotes.by: by 表示方式，如 by mail，不接 the enclosed envelope

questions.prompt: We are pleased to announce the opening of ___ new branch in Kaohsiung.
questions.explanation: 名詞 branch 前面用所有格形容詞 our。

optionNotes.ours: 所有格代名詞單獨使用，後面不接名詞

questions.prompt: Ms. Wang will be out of the office ___ next Monday.
questions.explanation: 不在辦公室是「持續的狀態」，持續到下週一 → until。

optionNotes.by: by 用於「在期限前完成」的動作
optionNotes.for: for 接一段時間，不接時間點

questions.prompt: Sales have increased ___ 15 percent compared to last year.
questions.explanation: increase by + 數量 = 增加了多少；increase to = 增加到多少。

optionNotes.to: increase to 15 percent 是「增加到 15%」，語意不同
optionNotes.at: increase 不搭配 at 表示幅度
optionNotes.with: increase 不搭配 with 表示幅度

questions.prompt: The board will ___ the proposal at next week's meeting.
questions.explanation: discuss 是及物動詞，直接接受詞，不加 about。

optionNotes.discuss about: discuss 後面不加 about（常見錯誤）
optionNotes.discussion: 名詞，will 後面要接動詞

questions.prompt: The museum is ___ located near the train station.
questions.explanation: 修飾過去分詞 located 用副詞：conveniently 方便地。

optionNotes.convenient: 形容詞不能修飾分詞 located

questions.prompt: It is important that every employee ___ the safety guidelines.
questions.explanation: It is important / essential that + 主詞 + (should) + 原形動詞（多益常考的假設語氣）。

optionNotes.follows: 這個句型要用原形動詞（美式口語偶爾會聽到 follows，但考試要選原形）
optionNotes.followed: 這個句型要用原形動詞

questions.prompt: The keynote speaker ___ at 10 a.m. tomorrow.
questions.explanation: be scheduled to + V：預定要…（行程是被安排的 → 被動）。

optionNotes.scheduled to speak: 缺少 be 動詞，句子沒有主要動詞
optionNotes.is scheduling to speak: 主動進行式語意錯誤：講者不是在安排行程

questions.prompt: I would have attended the workshop if I ___ about it earlier.
questions.explanation: 與過去事實相反的假設：If + had + p.p., S + would have + p.p.

optionNotes.knew: knew 用於與「現在」事實相反
optionNotes.have known: if 子句要用過去完成式

questions.prompt: Mr. Brown is one of ___ experienced engineers in the company.
questions.explanation: one of the + 最高級 + 複數名詞：最…的其中之一。

optionNotes.the more: the more… the more… 是另一個句型

questions.prompt: Please fill ___ this form and return it to the front desk. (填寫)
questions.explanation: fill out / fill in a form 都是「填寫表格」。

questions.prompt: The meeting has been called ___ because the manager is sick. (取消)
questions.explanation: call off = cancel 取消。

questions.prompt: Could you look ___ this report before the meeting? (過目、檢查一遍)
questions.explanation: look over / look through：快速檢查、瀏覽一遍。

questions.prompt: We need to come ___ with a new marketing plan. (想出)
questions.explanation: come up with：想出（點子、計畫）。

questions.prompt: The plane will take ___ in ten minutes. (起飛)
questions.explanation: take off：（飛機）起飛；land 是降落。

questions.prompt: Please hold ___ while I transfer your call. (電話中「請稍候」)
questions.explanation: hold on：（電話中）請稍等。也可以說 Please hold.

questions.prompt: I'm afraid we have run ___ of paper. (用完)
questions.explanation: run out of：用完、耗盡。

questions.prompt: Past tense of "lead": She ___ the team to success last year.
questions.explanation: lead 的過去式與過去分詞都是 led（不是 leaded）。

questions.prompt: Plural of "analysis": We compared several ___.
questions.explanation: analysis → analyses（-is 結尾的名詞複數改成 -es，例如 crisis → crises）。

questions.prompt: Noun form of "apply" (申請書): Please submit your ___ by Friday.
questions.explanation: apply（v.）申請 → application（n.）申請書；applicant 是「申請人」。

questions.prompt: Adjective form of "respond" (反應快的): Our support team is very ___.
questions.explanation: respond（v.）→ responsive（adj.）反應迅速的；response（n.）回應。

questions.prompt: Opposite of "increase": Sales began to ___ in March. (減少)
questions.explanation: decrease / decline / drop / fall 都可以表示「下降、減少」。

questions.prompt: She was ___ to manager last month. (升職，用被動語態)
questions.explanation: be promoted to + 職位：被升職為…

questions.prompt: Please ___ me know if you have any questions. (讓我知道)
questions.explanation: let me know：讓我知道（let + 受詞 + 原形動詞）。

questions.prompt: Thank you for your ___. We will reply within 24 hours. (詢問，美式拼法)
questions.explanation: inquiry（美式）/ enquiry（英式）：詢問。

questions.prompt: Choose the best response: "When does the meeting start?"
questions.explanation: When 問「時間」，要回答時間。多益 Part 2 常考：先聽清楚開頭的疑問詞。

When 問句不能用 Yes/No 回答

questions.prompt: Choose the best response: "Who is in charge of the new project?"
questions.explanation: Who 問「人」，回答人名或職位。

Who 問句不能用 Yes/No 回答，而且重複 new 是陷阱

questions.prompt: Choose the best response: "Why was the shipment delayed?"
questions.explanation: Why 問「原因」，常用 Because / Due to 回答。

questions.prompt: Choose the best response: "Would you like me to send the file now?"
questions.explanation: Would you like me to…? 是「要我幫你…嗎？」的提議，接受時說 Yes, that would be great / Yes, please。

把提議誤解成問「喜不喜歡」
主詞換成 He，且重複 send 是常見陷阱

questions.prompt: Choose the best response: "How long will the renovation take?"
questions.explanation: How long 問「多久」，回答一段時間。

用 long 製造聯想的陷阱
since 表示起點，不是回答需要多久

questions.prompt: Choose the best response: "Haven't you finished the report yet?"
questions.explanation: 否定疑問句：直接說明實際狀況最自然。

Yes 後面要接肯定（Yes, I have.），Yes + haven't 自相矛盾
只重複 report，沒有回答有沒有完成

questions.prompt: Choose the best response: "Can we reschedule our meeting?"
options: The schedule is on the wall.
questions.explanation: reschedule 改期 → 同意並提出新時間。

重複 schedule 的聲音陷阱
重複 schedule 的聲音陷阱

questions.prompt: Choose the best response: "Do you know where the conference room is?"
options: It's at the end of the hall.
questions.answer: It's at the end of the hall.
questions.explanation: Do you know where…? 實際上是問地點，直接回答位置。

questions.prompt: "We're on a tight budget." What does this mean?
questions.explanation: tight budget：預算吃緊。相反是 a generous budget。

optionNotes.預算被取消了: 取消是 the budget was cut / canceled

questions.prompt: "Let's call it a day." What does this mean?
questions.explanation: call it a day：今天的工作到此為止。

optionNotes.打電話給某人: call 在這裡不是打電話
optionNotes.明天再打電話: 與 call 的字面意思混淆

questions.prompt: "Could you give me a ballpark figure?" What is the speaker asking for?
questions.explanation: ballpark figure：大概的估計值，例如報價前先問大概多少錢。

optionNotes.棒球比賽的分數: ballpark 原意是棒球場，但這是慣用語

questions.prompt: "The project is behind schedule." What does this mean?
questions.explanation: behind schedule：落後進度；ahead of schedule：超前；on schedule：準時。

optionNotes.照計畫進行: 照計畫是 on schedule / on track

questions.prompt: "I'll get back to you by Friday." What does the speaker mean?
questions.explanation: get back to someone：之後再回覆某人。

optionNotes.週五會回到辦公室: 回到辦公室是 be back in the office
optionNotes.週五要把東西還你: 還東西是 give it back to you
optionNotes.週五前要離開: 與 get back 的意思相反

questions.prompt: "Please keep me in the loop." What does this mean?
options: 有進展請隨時讓我知道
questions.answer: 有進展請隨時讓我知道
questions.explanation: keep someone in the loop：讓某人持續掌握最新資訊。

optionNotes.請幫我保密: 保密是 keep it confidential / between us

questions.prompt: "We can't afford to cut corners on safety." What does "cut corners" mean?
questions.explanation: cut corners：為了省時省錢而走捷徑、降低品質。

optionNotes.削減部門: 削減是 cut a department / downsize
optionNotes.準時完成: 準時完成是 finish on time

questions.prompt: "I'm swamped with work this week." What does this mean?
questions.explanation: be swamped with：被（工作）淹沒，非常忙。

optionNotes.在沼澤附近工作: swamp 原意是沼澤，但這是比喻

questions.prompt: Which closing is most appropriate for a formal business email?
questions.explanation: 正式商業書信常用 Best regards, / Kind regards, / Sincerely,。

optionNotes.Love,: 用於家人或很親近的朋友

questions.prompt: Which is the most polite way to decline an invitation?
options: Thank you for inviting me, but I'm afraid I can't make it.
questions.answer: Thank you for inviting me, but I'm afraid I can't make it.
questions.explanation: 先感謝，再用 I'm afraid… 委婉拒絕；can't make it = 沒辦法到。

questions.prompt: "The printer is out of order." What does this mean?
questions.explanation: out of order：故障、無法使用。

optionNotes.印表機已經訂購了: order 也有「訂購」的意思，是陷阱

questions.prompt: In a job ad, what does "benefits package" mean?
questions.explanation: benefits package：薪水以外的福利，例如保險、年假、退休金。

questions.prompt: "Flight 207 is now boarding at Gate 12." What should passengers of Flight 207 do?
questions.explanation: boarding：正在登機；Gate 12：12 號登機門。

questions.prompt: "Please RSVP by June 5." What should you do?
options: 6 月 5 日前回覆是否出席
questions.answer: 6 月 5 日前回覆是否出席
questions.explanation: RSVP 來自法文 répondez s'il vous plaît，意思是「請回覆（是否出席）」。

questions.prompt: "This offer is valid until the end of the month." What does this mean?
questions.explanation: valid until：有效期到…

optionNotes.這個提議被拒絕了: offer 在這裡是「優惠」，不是提議

questions.prompt: "Mr. Tanaka is on leave this week." What does this mean?
questions.explanation: on leave：休假中；leave 當名詞是「休假」，例如 sick leave（病假）。

optionNotes.他已經離職了: 離職是 has left the company

questions.prompt: "We need to meet the deadline." What does "meet" mean here?
questions.explanation: meet the deadline：趕上截止期限；meet 也可以是 meet requirements（符合要求）。

optionNotes.見面: meet 最常見的意思，但這裡是「達成」
optionNotes.認識: 認識新朋友才是這個意思
optionNotes.延後: 延後是 extend / postpone the deadline
